name: MCat WooCommerce Tools
author: marketCAT

sections.description:
MCat WooCommerce Tools (formerly MCat Source) is the ultimate all-in-one toolkit for WooCommerce store owners. It combines marketing analytics with essential store management and UX features to help you run your store more efficiently and boost sales.

Key Features:

1. Customer Source & Analytics (“Where did you hear about us?”)
* Adds a customizable question to the checkout or “Thank You” page.
* Smart Analytics: Displays a summary of customer answers in the admin panel.
* CSV Export: Exports a full report combining Customer Declaration, WooCommerce Order Attribution (UTMs), and PixelYourSite Data.

2. Store Management Tools (Admin Only)
* Total Sold Badge: See exactly how many times a product has been sold directly on the shop loop.
* Variation Stock: View stock quantities for every variation directly on the single product page.
* Top 5 Variants: Instantly see the best-selling variants for variable products.
* Admin SKU: Displays the SKU on the front end.
(Note: These tools are strictly visible only to logged-in users with “manage_woocommerce” capabilities. Your customers will not see them).

3. Frontend Tools (UX & Sales Boosters)
* Free Shipping Bar: A dynamic progress bar showing customers how much more they need to spend to get free shipping. Customizable colors, threshold, and locations (Cart, Checkout, Shop).
* Products Per Page Selector: Give customers a dropdown to control how many products they view per page, improving browsing comfort.

4. Quick Emails (Order Management)
* Configure up to 5 quick email buttons inside the WooCommerce order view (sidebar).
* Instantly send tracking links, order updates, or custom messages with a single click.
* Supports dynamic tags like {order_id} and {input_value} for text fields.

HPOS Compatible: Fully compatible with High-Performance Order Storage.
Translation Ready: Fully prepared for localization (currently optimized for PL/EN).
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/marketcat-ecommerce-analytics directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to MCat Tools in the left WordPress admin menu to configure settings.
sections.faq:
Does it work with High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS)?

Yes, the plugin is fully compatible with HPOS.

Are the Admin Tools visible to my customers?

No. Features like Variation Stock, Total Sales, Top 5 Variants, and Admin SKU are strictly protected and visible only to logged-in administrators and shop managers.

Can I translate the plugin?

Yes, the plugin is fully internationalized. You can use software like Poedit or the Loco Translate plugin to translate it into your language. The settings panel is natively available in Polish.
